review.note: No independent record found of an establishment action on Sept. 11, 1984. NPS's own legislative list gives 1984 acts of July 18 (P.L. 98-369) and Oct. 17 (P.L. 98-482) only, and the exact 20-year match with the 1964 act raises the chance of an Index error. Check for a Secretary's establishment notice in the Federal Register (Sept. 1984) or ask the park.
